title: El Hotel de Mazamitla, MAJESTIC STORIES
comment: hotel-mazamitla (MAJESTIC): recepción de un hotel de montaña de lujo en Mazamitla, Jalisco, de noche. Ropa de diario, sin uniformes. Caras comunes, no famosas; los tres se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.SEBASTIAN_LOZADA: Mexican man, spoiled son of a rich hotel chain owner, 29 years old, fair skin, styled swept-back light-brown hair, clean-shaven, an arrogant smirk, a camel wool coat over a white turtleneck sweater, an expensive watch, his hands empty.
chars.LILIANA_CRUZ: Mexican woman, night receptionist of the hotel, 27 years old, warm brown skin, long dark-brown hair in a neat low ponytail, calm intelligent dark eyes, light makeup, a plain dark-green knit cardigan over a white blouse (everyday clothes, not a uniform), small gold stud earrings, her hands empty.
chars.ALFONSO_LOZADA: Mexican man, powerful owner of a hotel chain, 62 years old, fair tanned skin, silver hair neatly combed, a short trimmed grey beard, warm but commanding grey eyes, a dark charcoal overcoat over a navy suit with an open-collar light-blue shirt, his hands empty.

locs.LOC_HOTELMAZAMITLA: Lobby and reception of a luxury mountain lodge hotel in Mazamitla, Jalisco, at night: a polished dark-wood reception counter with a small brass bell and a lamp, stone walls, a big lit stone fireplace, wooden beams, leather armchairs, large windows with dark pine forest outside, warm amber light, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
